No new ideas today: two short problems on your course project (Online
activities 9, 10 and 11). Do each one alone. Tap, sort or type your answer
at every step: the page checks it at once and tells you why.

## Recall

- **The service:** a form whose responses fill a sheet (Lecture 8).
- **The website:** Home, Service and Contact, a button to the form,
  published (Lecture 9).
- **The marketing:** a post with a free picture and its source, and a
  short plan (Lecture 10).

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Recall"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="the Contact page|a PDF"}
Where are the responses of the form?
:   in its sheet: one row for each response

    Why: Each response is one row of the sheet of the form.

Which link goes into the button Book now?
:   the link of the form

    Why: The button opens the form, so the customer can book.

What is written under a free picture from Canva?
:   Photo: Canva

    Why: Write the source of a picture that is not yours.
:::
:::

## Activity 1 · Check your project

Before the talk, Sami checks his project, *Fix It*, part by part. Check
yours in the same way.

::: {.callout-note title="Activity 1 · The project check · 15 min"}
1. Open the link of your form on your phone and send one test response.
2. Open the web address of your site on your phone: the three pages, the
   menu (≡) and the button.
3. Look at your post: the words of your service, the photo and *Photo:
   Canva*.

*Your product:* a project in which every part works.

::: {.sort}
Sami's checks. Which part of the project does each one check?

the form
:   One test response arrives in the sheet.

    Why: The form fills its sheet.

the website
:   The button Book now opens the form.

    Why: The site links to the form.

:   The menu shows Home, Service and Contact on a phone.

    Why: The site works on a phone.

the post
:   The line Photo: Canva is under the picture.

    Why: The post gives the source of the picture.
:::

::: {.choice}
Sami's site opens on his laptop, but not on Lina's phone. What is wrong?

- [x] He did not press Publish.

  Why: Only a published site opens for other people.

- [ ] Lina's phone is too old.

  Why: A published site opens on every phone.

- [ ] The site has three pages.

  Why: Three pages are right.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · The check"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="delete the form|nothing"}
A test response does not arrive. What do you check first?
:   the link of the form

    Why: Maybe the button opens another link.

The post has a photo from Google Images. What do you do?
:   change it to a free photo, with its source

    Why: A picture found on the Internet belongs to someone.
:::
:::

## Activity 2 · Three slides and a talk of three minutes

The talk has three slides, one minute each. Sami makes his in PowerPoint
(Online activity 4 showed how).

::: {.callout-note title="Activity 2 · The talk · 15 min"}
1. Slide 1: the name of the service, the customer and the need.
2. Slide 2: a screenshot of the website and the link of the form.
3. Slide 3: the post and the goal of the plan (for example *20 bookings
   this month*).
4. Say the talk aloud once, with a timer: three minutes.

*Your product:* `project.pptx`, three slides.

::: {.order}
Put the three slides of the talk in order.

1. The service, the customer and the need
2. The website and the form
3. The post and the goal of the plan

Why: First what the service is, then how it works, then how people hear about it.
:::

::: {.choice}
Sami's slide 1 has eight long sentences. What does he do?

- [x] keep three short points, and say the rest

  Why: Few words on a slide; the details are what you say.

- [ ] make the font smaller

  Why: A smaller font does not fix too much text.

- [ ] add a second slide 1

  Why: The talk has three slides.
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · The talk"}
Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="ten minutes|twenty slides"}
How long is the talk?
:   three minutes

    Why: One minute for each slide.

Which layout puts the screenshot of the site next to three points?
:   Two Content

    Why: Two boxes side by side.
:::
:::

## Wrap-up {.summary}

- You can check that every part of your digital service works: the form,
  the website, the post.
- You can present your project in three slides and three minutes.
